stable.notes: Your domains, not ours. The Meetings Library picker used to require folders named after one person's business units, so nobody else could point it anywhere. Any subfolder holding a meetings/ folder now counts, whatever it is called, spaces included, and when a folder will not work the message says which of the three reasons applies instead of leaving you guessing. A fresh COS starts with two domains, personal and business, and files each meeting by what was said in it. Set your own in .cos-profile.json. Needs glasses-server 6.21.31.
